rules.title: An Act prohibiting algorithmic rent setting (S.2983)
rules.requirement: A Massachusetts Senate bill would prohibit landlords from setting rents with algorithms, but it is not law. It was reported favorably by the Joint Committee on Housing on 3/12/2026 and sent to Senate Ways and Means.

coverage.summary: Bill text not included in this document; as a conduct prohibition it would apply statewide to rental housing if enacted.

rules.citation: S.2983 (194th General Court; new draft of S.994 and S.1016)
rules.quoted_span: An Act prohibiting algorithmic rent setting

notes: The document is only the bill history page for S.2983. It gives the title, sponsors of the predecessor bills (S.994 and S.1016) and the committee actions on 3/12/2026. It has no operative text, so the record has no covered software, prohibited conduct, penalties or effective date. The bill remains pending in Senate Ways and Means as of retrieval.
